decisions.title: Motion purpose allowlist — feedback, continuity, hierarchy, state
decisions.decision: Motion is allowed only for: (1) Feedback (saved, failed, toggled), (2) Continuity (shared-element orientation), (3) Hierarchy (attention to primary action), (4) State (expand/collapse, enter/exit). Forbidden: idle flair, perpetual loops, and “AI awake” breathing glows as identity. Motion communicates; it does not entertain for its own sake.
decisions.reason: Principle M-1 — Motion is meaning. Elevates concrete purpose allowlist + AI-identity refuse beyond GOV-063 general meaning law.

evidence.quote: Allowed purposes: 1. Feedback (saved, failed, toggled) 2. Continuity (shared-element orientation) 3. Hierarchy (attention to primary action) 4. State (expand/collapse, enter/exit)
Forbidden purposes: idle flair, perpetual loops, “AI awake” breathing glows as identity.
Define when and why AIIMIN moves — so motion communicates rather than entertains.

decisions.implementation_impact: Motion PRs must declare which allowlisted purpose they serve. Reject idle loops and AI breathing-glow identity. Spatial continuity = Continuity purpose (shared-element), not a separate inventable category.

decisions.title: Duration band — ~150–250ms micro; longer needs narrative reason
decisions.decision: Prefer ~150–250ms for micro-interactions. Longer motion requires a narrative reason (e.g. first-run brand moment), not a dashboard habit.
decisions.reason: Principle M-2 — Short by default. Supplies the duration band Constitution explicitly deferred to Motion Principles.

evidence.quote: Prefer ~150–250ms for micro-interactions. Longer motion needs a narrative reason (first-run brand moment), not a dashboard habit.
Craft history already set discipline: ~150–250ms, opacity+transform, max 2–3 intentional motions per composition.

decisions.implementation_impact: Default micro tokens live in ~150–250ms band. Brand/first-run may exceed with documented narrative reason. Resolve CF-M-001 with GOV-118 (platform vernacular) via REC-044 — emotional tempo wins over literal ms when OS tokens differ.

decisions.title: Prefer opacity + transform; avoid layout thrash and vestibular distress
decisions.decision: Prefer fade/slide/scale (opacity + transform) over layout thrash and blur fireworks. Avoid motion that causes vestibular distress.
decisions.reason: Principle M-3 — Opacity + transform preferred. Technique law + a11y bound.

evidence.quote: Prefer fade/slide/scale over layout thrash and blur fireworks. Avoid motion that causes vestibular distress (see Accessibility).
Craft history already set discipline: ~150–250ms, opacity+transform, max 2–3 intentional motions per composition.

decisions.implementation_impact: Default enter/exit/feedback use opacity+transform. Ban blur-firework and large unexpected layout thrash on product surfaces. Vestibular-safe alternatives required under reduced motion.

decisions.title: Motion budget per composition — brand 2–3; product fewer
decisions.decision: Marketing/brand compositions may use 2–3 intentional motions to create presence. Product OS surfaces use fewer. If everything moves, calm is dead.
decisions.reason: Principle M-4 — Budget per composition. Operationalizes calm under Human Momentum.

evidence.quote: Marketing/brand: 2–3 intentional motions can create presence. Product OS: fewer. If everything moves, calm is dead.
Craft history already set discipline: ~150–250ms, opacity+transform, max 2–3 intentional motions per composition.

decisions.implementation_impact: Brand/landing: cap intentional motions at 2–3 per composition. Product OS: prefer 0–1 motion moments per view unless purpose-justified. Motion reviews count intentional motions.

decisions.title: Never delay capture — animate after commit, not before
decisions.decision: Motion must not add latency to save/log/toggle paths. Feedback may animate after commit, not before.
decisions.reason: Principle M-6 — Never delay capture. Motion subordinate to capture speed and ceremony-free save.

evidence.quote: Motion must not add latency to save/log/toggle paths. Feedback can animate after commit, not before.

decisions.implementation_impact: Commit/save/toggle execute immediately. Success/fail feedback may animate after state lands. Never gate commit behind animation start or duration.

decisions.title: One easing family per surface class
decisions.decision: Use one easing family per surface class. Do not mix bouncy carnival with corporate easeInOut randomly.
decisions.reason: Principle M-7 — Consistent physics metaphor. Consistency law for motion identity.

evidence.quote: One easing family per surface class. Do not mix bouncy carnival with corporate easeInOut randomly.

decisions.implementation_impact: Define surface classes (e.g. Product OS, Brand/Marketing, Capture micro) each with one easing family. No ad-hoc bounce on product chrome. Named curves deferred to Design System Spec (REC-042).

decisions.title: Platform vernacular OK — emotional tempo must match
decisions.decision: Native may use platform motion tokens; web may use its motion stack — but emotional tempo (calm, quick, purposeful) must match across surfaces.
decisions.reason: Principle M-8 — Platform vernacular. Consistency of feeling over identical implementation.

evidence.quote: Native may use platform motion tokens; web may use Framer/Motion — but emotional tempo (calm, quick, purposeful) must match.
Native has its own motion language doc; principles must keep web and native emotionally consistent.

decisions.implementation_impact: Do not force identical ms/easing libraries across web/native. Audit emotional tempo: calm, quick, purposeful. Resolve duration-band tension with GOV-113 via REC-044.

decisions.title: Celebration rare and proportional — no habit-tick fireworks
decisions.decision: Completion may acknowledge; it must not fireworks every habit tick. XP celebration ≠ confetti addiction. Success motion stays proportional to stakes.
decisions.reason: Principle M-9 — Celebration is rare and proportional. Elevates success-motion law beyond GOV-055 anti-casino.

sections: M-9 — Celebration is rare and proportional
evidence.quote: Completion can acknowledge; it must not fireworks every habit tick. XP celebration ≠ confetti addiction.

decisions.implementation_impact: Habit ticks: quiet/instant or minimal ack. Reserve richer celebration for meaningful milestones aligned with XP role (GOV-068). No confetti loops.

decisions.title: Page transitions orient — not cinematic taxes on daily use
decisions.decision: Route/page changes may gently orient the user; they must not become cinematic taxes on daily use.
decisions.reason: Principle M-10 — Page transitions serve orientation. Navigation motion = orientation, not spectacle.

evidence.quote: Route changes may gently orient; they must not become cinematic taxes on daily use.

decisions.implementation_impact: Default route transitions: short, orienting, skippable under reduced motion. Ban long cinematic page plays on daily OS paths.

decisions.title: Loading motion must not mask poor performance
decisions.decision: Loading animations must not be used to mask poor performance. Motion may communicate waiting state; it must not disguise latency as craft.
decisions.reason: Known risks — Loading animations masking poor performance. Implied by Purpose (communicate, not entertain) + capture/performance posture.

evidence.quote: Define when and why AIIMIN moves — so motion communicates rather than entertains.

decisions.implementation_impact: Treat slow loads as performance bugs first. Loading motion = honest wait signal, not polish theater. Pair with sync honesty (GOV-089).
